title: Piano Waterfall Surreal
description: A grand piano transformed into a cascading waterfall sits in a mountainous landscape. Green slimy tentacles and eye-like orbs emerge from the piano's open lid and body while green hands play the keys, with water flowing from the keyboard into a pool below.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape featuring a ruined grand piano perched on rocks in a mountain valley, its open lid covered in green slimy tentacles and glowing blue eyes, green monstrous hands playing the keys as water cascades like a waterfall from the piano body and keys into a pool below, ancient ruins visible on the left, dramatic purple and green sky with aurora, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting
